direction: Reduce full training+online update+inference cost of the T38 factorized causal-composition mechanism, without tuning against consumed T38 validation. Prove native headroom before originating a NEW pair/graph scientific source.
mathematical_mechanism: TRAIN-fitted P(G)P(H)P(OP) over 128 possible two-gate XOR/AND compositions. Compile each rule's output into eight 128-bit masks and score each latent program. Maintain exact surviving-program mask under each arriving public rule-bit observation; at each observation, update a cached eight-pattern predictive probability vector, with exact certifications from 256-rule public evidence independent of probabilistic gate support. Query this persistent sufficient statistic directly, without rescanning all compositions.
fairness: All matched full-rule and joint controls use public-only EM and equally compiled incremental posterior summaries; never compare only against a noncached/weak baseline. Independent, simpler Beta and uniform exact also count for overall CPU/RSS threshold.

sourcefree_math.program_space: 8 previously defined two-input Boolean gate atoms for each role times XOR/AND; latent 128, truth tables all 256
sourcefree_math.dimensions: 3 input pattern bits from 0..7; pure Boolean source-free algebra, no entity-graph source family
sourcefree_math.guarantee_train_role_exposure: Explicit fixed first 16 META programs cover each of G=0..7 and H=0..7 in both roles; next 24 sample only training-eligible pairs; private IDs may be audited but not used to fit. All future science cohorts will have a separately frozen source and guaranteed role coverage before original first use.

proofs.each_of_24_validation_streams: Compare exact program compatibility, eight compiled learned predictive marginals, and exact all-256-rule certification at every observation, against independent recomputation from original public clauses. Candidate ablation to uniform factors must change posterior probability on at least one validation stream without changing certified answers.
proofs.work_not_just_cache: Record actual per-public-event 128-program compatibility checks, cached weighted accumulator rebuild events, and inference query ops for learned and equally TRAIN-fitted joint/full controls; do not claim scientific transfer for fewer ops than naive controls.
